rows.grounds: compound of twenty-one, cubit, and end; accusative limit

items.question: What upper cubit limit results from increasing by two cubits starting from three cubits?
items.inference: The measure ranges from three cubits to twenty-one cubits by two-cubit increments.
uncertainties: exact grammatical case of compound members not specified
items.plain_english: The measure extends up to twenty-one cubits, indeed from three cubits by two-cubit increase.
